params.caption: 🎮 Take-Two CEO: hit games are still made by humans, not AI On Take-Two's latest earnings call, an investor raised worries about AI tools that compile and decompile game code. CEO Strauss Zelnick again backed his developers, saying making hits "remains the purview of human beings". 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 01:47 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer #TakeTwo #GTA6 #GamingNews
